WITH per_status AS (
    SELECT
        CENTROMEA AS status,
        AVG(HGB) AS avg_hemoglobin,
        AVG((`T-BIL` * 1.0) / NULLIF(CRE, 0)) AS avg_test_ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'
    GROUP BY CENTROMEA
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_test_ratio) AS mean_status_avg_ratio
    FROM per_status
)
SELECT
    p.status,
    p.avg_hemoglobin,
    p.avg_test_ratio,
    p.avg_test_ratio / NULLIF(o.mean_status_avg_ratio, 0) AS ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM per_status AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.mean_status_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: A test's bilirubin-to-creatinine ratio is undefined when CRE is zero, so those rows are ignored in the average; SQL AVG also ignores rows with either value missing. The overall mean is the unweighted mean of the nonmissing status-level average ratios, with missing CENTROMEA values grouped as NULL.
